verifies.G056-C2: an entity with @CreatedDate and a registered AuditingEntityListener gets a warning that @EnableJpaAuditing is declared nowhere in the project (the project index must have read every Java, Kotlin and XML source first); the listener warning is absent because the listener is registered. A project that declares it is the negative case of RS-474. XML-only enabling is recognised through the jpa:auditing element (unit test). It is a source-level absence check, not the IDE's configuration model.
